core.title: Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Alpine Meadow Carbon Flux Dataset 2015-2024
core.description: A decade-long ecological dataset of carbon, water, and energy fluxes from alpine meadow observation sites on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.
contributors: Haibei Alpine Meadow Ecosystem Research Station
funders: Second Tibetan Plateau Scientific Expedition and Research Program, 2019QZKK0301
National Natural Science Foundation of China, 42130506

ecological_identification_information.Resource Name: Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Alpine Meadow Carbon Flux Dataset 2015-2024
ecological_identification_information.Abstract: The dataset contains half-hourly and daily aggregated eddy-covariance observations, meteorological variables, soil temperature and moisture profiles, vegetation survey records, and site-level metadata for alpine meadow ecosystems.
ecological_identification_information.Dataset Creators: Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Ecological Observation Network; Zhao Lin; Tsering Dawa; He Qiang
ecological_identification_information.Use Restrictions: Non-commercial research use. Users must cite the dataset and contact the station before using raw high-frequency flux data for site-comparison publications.

Data Entity.Entity Description: Half-hourly CO2, H2O, and energy fluxes with quality-control flags and meteorological drivers.

ecological_data_quality_and_methods.Data Quality Description: Flux records include friction-velocity filtering, spike detection, stationarity tests, footprint screening, and gap-filling quality flags. Daily aggregates are only produced when valid half-hourly coverage exceeds 70 percent.
ecological_data_quality_and_methods.Data Generation Method: CO2 and H2O fluxes were measured using open-path infrared gas analyzers and three-dimensional sonic anemometers. Meteorological observations were collected with calibrated radiation, temperature, humidity, precipitation, and soil sensors.
ecological_data_quality_and_methods.Data Collection and Processing Methods: Raw 10 Hz data were processed with coordinate rotation, time-lag correction, density correction, spike removal, and standardized quality-control procedures. Vegetation surveys were digitized and linked to site metadata.
ecological_data_quality_and_methods.Quality Control Description: Quality-control codes follow 0 for high quality, 1 for moderate quality, and 2 for low confidence. Missing records are encoded as NA and documented in monthly processing logs.
ecological_data_quality_and_methods.Data Source: Haibei Alpine Meadow Ecosystem Research Station; Maqu Grassland Flux Tower; Nagqu Alpine Meadow Observation Site

Spatial Range.Geographic Description: Alpine meadow observation sites on the northeastern and central Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
